search: best-first cumulative policy surprisal of deviations; exact prefix replay; greedy suffix
autonomous: fixed-parent stochastic discovery plus success-filtered self-training; not PPO
information: interrupted teaching starts only after observed intervention resolves; pre-response prefix replayed and masked; no-interruption conditions declare passive opponent
grading: original board and wind targets; under interruption hand lower bound reduced by one; not proof of optimal functional interactions
reserved: same elfnote development lineage; new seed sequences and handtrap swap; never collection or optimizer input
minimum_gain: search-trained endpoint must improve over autonomous by at least 2 of 12 training conditions while retaining 5 original goals and 5 old anchors; reserved improvement separately reported; no promotion

calibration.input: mask ignored for ordinary observations; selected group live only during current card selection
